typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		LAST_DCL_DT as timestamp,
		TABLENAME as string,
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DQL_DT as timestamp,
		LAST_DML_DT as timestamp,
		CURRENT_PERM_MB as long,
		SYS_ID as string,
		CREATE_DT as timestamp,
		CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_DDL_DT as timestamp,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		LAST_ALTER_DT as timestamp,
		CREATORNAME as string,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT as timestamp,
		CREATOR_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    SYS_ID  ,DATABASENAME  ,TABLENAME  ,CREATORNAME  ,CREATOR_FULL_NAME  ,CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR   ,CREATE_DT  ,LAST_ALTER_DT  ,LAST_DCL_DT  ,LAST_DDL_DT  ,LAST_DML_DT   ,LAST_DQL_DT  ,LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT   ,CURRENT_PERM_MB   ,RPT_DT from TDINFINFO.V_PR00045_ENTPS_SNDBX_TBL_90DAY_AGED_HIST qualify RPT_DT >= add_months(max(RPT_DT) over (), -3)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ADONETSource
ADONETSource sink(input(
		LAST_DCL_DT as string,
		TABLENAME as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		LAST_DQL_DT as string,
		LAST_DML_DT as string,
		CURRENT_PERM_MB as string,
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		CREATE_DT as string,
		CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR as string,
		LAST_DDL_DT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		LAST_ALTER_DT as string,
		CREATOR_NAME as string,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT as string,
		CREATOR_FULL_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		LAST_DCL_DT,
		TABLENAME,
		RPT_DT,
		LAST_DQL_DT,
		LAST_DML_DT,
		CURRENT_PERM_MB,
		ENVRN_TXT = SYS_ID,
		CREATE_DT,
		CREATOR_EMAIL_ADDR,
		LAST_DDL_DT,
		DATABASENAME,
		LAST_ALTER_DT,
		CREATOR_NAME = CREATORNAME,
		LAST_OTHER_SQL_DT,
		CREATOR_FULL_NAME)) ~> OLEDBDestination
